annotations.grafana.app/message: pi-flow cost dashboard (PMR-XPVE M5): cost by ref/phase/agent/subtask + token totals from Pushgateway metrics

spec.description: One row per ticket (pushed within the selected range), newest first. Total = all sessions. Plan / Implement / Validate = cost per phase; Orchestrator = the main session's own cost only, never including subagents; Total = orchestrator + all subagent sessions (workers, reviewers, scouts). "–" = not recorded: plan/implement/orchestrator cost only exists for runs started after main-session tracking. Duration = summed phase wall-clock (includes waiting for you).
spec.title: Tickets: what each one cost and where

spec.expr: sum(sum by (ref) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow"} > (time() - 86400) and push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow"} <= time())) or vector(0)

spec.description: At each point: cost of the tickets whose metrics were pushed in the preceding 24 hours (push time = when the flow run ended). The right edge is "the last 24h until now"; flat zero = nothing finished that day. Rolling, so one run shows for 24h.
spec.title: Spend in the last 24h (rolling)

spec.description: One bar per flow ref; segments are phases (main session + workers). Hover a segment for that phase's cost. Metrics are pushed automatically when a flow run ends (manual retry: /flow-cost <ref> --push).
spec.title: Cost per flow, stacked by phase ($ref)

spec.expr: label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(topk(10, sum by (ref, agent, session, subtask) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref"})), "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*"), "role", "orchestrator", "role", "^main$"), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$"), "subtask", "–", "subtask", "^$"), "key", "|", "ref", "session")

spec.description: The ten single sessions with the highest cost. Role = agent name before the colon (orchestrator rows = the main session, cost summed over phases). Subtask = plan task for 1:1 workers. Tokens = all kinds (input, output, cache) for that session.
spec.title: Most expensive sessions (top 10)

spec.expr: sum by (ref) (pi_flow_tokens_total{ref=~"$ref", kind="cacheRead"}) / sum by (ref) (pi_flow_tokens_total{ref=~"$ref", kind=~"input|cacheRead|cacheWrite"}) and on (ref) (push_time_seconds{job="pi-flow"} >= (time() - $__range_s))

spec.description: Share of input-side tokens served from the prompt cache: cacheRead / (input + cacheRead + cacheWrite). Cache reads cost a fraction of fresh input, so a low ratio on an expensive ticket is where to look first. Covers workers (and the orchestrator for newer runs).
spec.title: Cache hit ratio per ticket (higher = cheaper)

spec.expr: max by (role) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (ref, role, session) ((sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref"}) * on (ref, session) group_left (role) pi_flow_run_role_info) or label_replace(sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref"}) unless on (ref, session) pi_flow_run_role_info, "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*")), "role", "orchestrator", "role", "^main$"), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$"))

avg by (role) (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (ref, role, session) ((sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref"}) * on (ref, session) group_left (role) pi_flow_run_role_info) or label_replace(sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref"}) unless on (ref, session) pi_flow_run_role_info, "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*")), "role", "orchestrator", "role", "^main$"), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$"))

quantile by (role) (0.5, label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (ref, role, session) ((sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref"}) * on (ref, session) group_left (role) pi_flow_run_role_info) or label_replace(sum by (ref, agent, session) (pi_flow_run_cost_usd{ref=~"$ref"}) unless on (ref, session) pi_flow_run_role_info, "role", "$1", "agent", "^([^:]*).*")), "role", "orchestrator", "role", "^main$"), "role", "review", "role", "^Review$"), "role", "deviation check", "role", "^Deviation check$"))

spec.description: Per agent ROLE. "orchestrator" = the main pi session that runs the flow, counting ONLY that session's own LLM calls (split across phases and summed per flow run); subagents (scouts, workers, reviewers, deviation checks) run in their own sessions and appear as their own roles, never inside the orchestrator. A ticket's total = orchestrator + all subagent sessions. Other roles: the agent type (scout, worker, reviewer, ...) when known, else the name before the colon. Highest = most expensive single session of that role; average and median are over the same sessions (one orchestrator session per flow run, so with few runs the three bars are equal). Runs pushed before role tracking fall back to the name-prefix rule.
spec.title: Cost per agent role: highest, average and median session ($ref)

spec.description: Sum of ticket totals for tickets pushed within the selected time range.
spec.title: Total spend

spec.description: Tickets with cost pushed within the selected time range.
spec.title: Tickets

spec.description: Mean ticket total in the selected range.
spec.title: Average per ticket

spec.description: Median ticket total in the selected range (less skewed by one expensive ticket than the average).
spec.title: Median per ticket
